**Moody Amakobe**

Deep learning is more than a sequence of landmark architectures. It is a connected engineering discipline in which representation, optimization, data, computation, deployment, and human judgment determine what systems can learn—and whether they work responsibly in the world.

## Who This Book Is For {.unnumbered}

This book is designed for graduate and advanced undergraduate students, instructors, technical professionals, and independent learners seeking a structured understanding of deep learning. Basic programming literacy is expected; algebra, introductory probability and statistics, and foundational machine-learning concepts are helpful.

## What You Will Learn {.unnumbered}

- How neural networks learn representations through forward computation, loss functions, backpropagation, and optimization
- How vision, sequence, Transformer, multimodal, generative, and reinforcement-learning architectures address different forms of data and interaction
- How to evaluate, integrate, deploy, monitor, and govern deep-learning systems beyond benchmark performance
- How technical design choices connect to reliability, access, accountability, and responsible practice

## The Five-Part Journey {.unnumbered}

::: {.part-grid}
::: {.part-card}
### Part I · Foundations {.unnumbered}
Neural computation, architectures, optimization, and the training process.
:::
::: {.part-card}
### Part II · Vision Systems {.unnumbered}
Convolution, feature hierarchies, dense prediction, and vision-pipeline evaluation.
:::
::: {.part-card}
### Part III · Sequence, Language, and Multimodal Learning {.unnumbered}
Memory, attention, Transformers, pre-training, and shared representations.
:::
::: {.part-card}
### Part IV · Generative and Adaptive Systems {.unnumbered}
Latent variables, adversarial learning, diffusion, and agents that learn from feedback.
:::
::: {.part-card}
### Part V · Engineering and Responsible Deep Learning {.unnumbered}
Production systems, infrastructure, governance, scale, and professional responsibility.
:::
:::
